_prototype_verification: PROTOTYPE rule pack. Numbers reflect publicly documented Ohio Job Creation Tax Credit parameters as of late 2025; verify all values (credit rate, term, thresholds, average wage requirement) against current Ohio Development Services Agency guidance and ORC § 122.17 before any real client use.

credit.name: Ohio Job Creation Tax Credit
credit.summary: Refundable tax credit awarded as a percentage of employee Ohio income tax withholding for net new jobs; amount and term set by negotiated agreement with Ohio Tax Credit Authority. This stub uses a representative per-job-equivalent amount for the demo.

thresholds._note: Ohio JCTC requires minimum 10 qualifying jobs at average wage ≥ $35,000/yr. Credits are negotiated individually; this stub represents a typical Columbus/Cincinnati-area award.

benefit._note: Simplified per-job equivalent. Actual JCTC is a % of withholding (up to 75%) for a negotiated term (up to 15 years). This stub converts a typical award to a per-job-year amount for comparability.

one_zero._doc_source: Approximation patched in via rules/_patch_one_zero.py; verify against state DOR before client use.
one_zero._note: OH JCTC: performance-based refundable; wage threshold per project agreement. entity_combination pending DISC-4 confirmation.
